title: Explainer lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Explainer templates were built and verified in: speaker lower third, compare columns, flow diagram, key term card, checklist, Venn diagram, quiz question and cycle loop.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 explainer template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction); the full-frame layouts also have a 'Light background' that stays in the template.
Clip ids are unique per comp (elt_, ecc_, efd_, ekt_, ecl_, evn_, eqz_, ecy_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/explainer_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
